tooltip_definitions.Total GAAP Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from long-read sequencing instruments, proprietary consumables, and service contracts ($40.56M in Q3 2026, up +5.5% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Consumables Revenue: Recurring SMRT Cells and sequencing reagent packs used on installed Revio and Vega sequencers ($20.80M in Q3 2026, surging +23.5% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Instrument Revenue: Capital equipment sales of Revio high-throughput long-read sequencers and benchtop Vega systems ($13.20M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Service & Other Revenue: Extended maintenance contracts, field support, and bioinformatics software subscriptions ($6.56M in Q3 2026, +12.3% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Revio System Placements: Shipments of PacBio's flagship high-throughput HiFi long-read sequencing platform (15 Revio units placed in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Vega Benchtop Sequencer: PacBio's newly launched benchtop long-read sequencer democratizing HiFi sequencing for regional laboratories (35 Vega units placed in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Annualized Revio Pull-Through: Annualized consumable pull-through per installed Revio sequencer (~$204,000 per system in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Gross Margin: GAAP gross margin of 33.21% ($13.47M gross profit) and Non-GAAP gross margin of 36.11% ($14.65M gross profit) in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted diluted loss per share excluding restructuring and intangible amortization (-$0.11 in Q3 2026 vs -$0.13 consensus).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Diluted EPS: GAAP diluted net loss per share of -$0.12 in Q3 2026 based on 315M weighted-average common shares.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Burn: Cash used in operating activities of -$34.87M in Q3 2026, reflecting continued operational restructuring and cost discipline.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures (-$37.47M in Q3 2026, after $2.60M CapEx).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Economic cash generation deducting CapEx ($2.60M) and SBC ($8.00M) from OCF (-$34.87M), yielding -$45.47M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Ending Cash & Investments: Total cash, cash equivalents, and liquid short-term investments of $199.4M as of September 30, 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Cash Flow Breakeven by 2028: Management's reiterated strategic financial commitment to reach operating cash flow breakeven by 2028 through restructuring savings.
tooltip_definitions.CFO Transition: Transition of CFO Jim Gibson into an advisory role effective November 3, 2026, while the company initiates an executive search.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity incentives of $8.00M in Q3 2026, down from $9.26M in Q2 2026 and $10.98M in Q3 2025.
tooltip_definitions.HiFi Sequencing Technology: PacBio's circular consensus sequencing technology delivering >99.9% read accuracy with long-read structural variant detection.
